methodology: Read public robots.txt sitemap declarations and XML sitemap children on the four requested main domains, plus the separately hosted Asaas blog and Hodle.
Count only sitemap page loc elements, not image loc elements. Remove English variants, OG/Twitter image routes, demo/debug paths and the unrelated meta-pixel page from the relevant set.

Inspect official product pages and search results for Pix APIs, collection, payment links, BaaS and embedded finance. Validate Hodle capabilities against live terms and the local product documentation.
Map related queries to one canonical intent rather than cloning a page for every phrase. Existing stablecoin and neobank pages retain their distinct intent.
limitations: Sitemap coverage is not proof of indexation, impressions, clicks, search volume or ranking. No competitor Search Console or keyword-intelligence dataset was available.
This is a topic coverage inventory, not all queries that generate competitor traffic. It does not promise a rank for the broad query Pix or universal search/AI visibility.
FAQ questions are editorial questions grounded in official documentation and observed product-page questions; the search tool did not provide a separate People Also Ask dataset.
Asaas blog advertises a category sitemap that returned HTTP 404; other available child sitemaps were read.
Woovi sitemap includes many social image URLs and language duplicates; raw totals are sitemap entries rather than unique indexable content.

The public nominal-account API guide returned HTTP 404. The account landing therefore describes the publicly offered partner account and commercial onboarding, and does not publish the unreleased opening endpoints from local source documentation.
